text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim: \"I personally believe that this new product will be a success\"","quality":"clear stance","description":"It states a definite position early so the reader immediately knows the writer’s argument."},{"evidence":"organized introduction, body, and conclusion","quality":"overall organization","description":"It follows a recognizable essay structure with a beginning, supporting middle, and closing."},{"evidence":"uses a concrete example from the article about General Motors and the special test track","quality":"relevant evidence use","description":"It brings in source-based detail to support the claim rather than relying only on personal opinion."},{"evidence":"explains that driverless cars will \"make life easier as far as transportation\" and links that to the example","quality":"development of ideas","description":"It offers some explanation of why the evidence supports the writer’s position instead of merely listing facts."},{"evidence":"smooth transitions such as \"To conclude\" and \"My only concern\"","quality":"coherence","description":"It uses basic transitions to connect ideas and make the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"mostly complete, readable sentences with conventional punctuation","quality":"sentence clarity","description":"Its wording is generally understandable and less disrupted by errors than the other essay."}]}
